expectations.text: The response does not invent company facts (revenue, users, market size) as if real
expectations.evidence: The document explicitly says “`【】` 内是需要你提供的事实/数字” and leaves revenue, users, market size, and financial forecasts as placeholders.

expectations.text: The response asks the user about purpose or context, or offers a planning step first
expectations.evidence: “现在需要你回答 8 个问题” includes “一句话讲清你的项目和所处行业” and asks about customers, traction, business model, team, and financing.
